annotations.title: Stair layout: straight, turned, concrete or steel

description: Lays out a flight as built: risers, goings, pitch, 2R+G, the floor opening for a headroom, the stringer as cut, timber and fixings (straight, landing or winders), or concrete and bars, or steel mass; both systems, limits read against a named code, a canvas link. Not sized.

detail.description: full (the default): the whole answer. summary: the result lines, the citation line and the page only — fewer tokens to read.

inputUnits.description: Send "base" to pass bare numbers on dimensioned inputs in base units (m, m², L, kg …), as the published test vectors are written. Without it a length, area or volume must carry its unit.

inputs.description: The stair page's inputs by id (totalRise, targetRiser, going, buildingCode …), each length with its unit; any left out opens at the page's own figure.

kind.description: straight: one timber flight; turned: an L or U on a landing or winders; concrete: a cast flight; steel: steel stringers with treads.

market.description: Optional. A market whose own opening choice some inputs take (a UK reader's code, an IEC motor), and whose currency symbol prints the caller's own money figures.

system.description: The unit system inputs left out open in, and the one the page link opens in. The answer comes in both.

name: stair_flight

imperial.description: The plan the page draws, in one system's stock lengths: every length in mm with both systems' readings; problems when the figures cannot be laid out.

metric.description: The plan the page draws, in one system's stock lengths: every length in mm with both systems' readings; problems when the figures cannot be laid out.

citation.description: The one citation line, built from the answer's own data.

lines.description: The result lines, as the report's table gives them.

notes.description: What a professional must decide, when to call one, a false-friend warning, that adoption is local: kept in every summary.
